title: Sweet Shop Picture Walk
hook: The picture starts the clue; the ingredient label finishes it.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D sweet-shop storybook, pastel bakery cases without readable labels, neat isolated treats, warm light

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading bakery labels with an adult
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: label cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/read gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a quiet acoustic shelf-pluck plus marimba confirmation.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a quiet acoustic shelf-pluck plus marimba confirmation
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Sweet Shop Picture Walk a label-literacy song: ingredient names, allergens, serving labels and product categories matter more than appearance; the child reads before assuming what a pastry contains.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child walks the display case reading name cards and ingredient/allergen notes, learning that visual similarity cannot guarantee recipe contents.
